name: Ore Excavation
description: Create Ore Excavation hides ore veins underground.

pages.title: Ore Excavation
pages.text:
Create Ore Excavation hides ore veins underground. You locate a vein, put a Drilling Machine on it, and it produces raw ore as long as it has [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]().\
\
Veins here are **finite** and run out.

pages.title: Ore Vein Finder
pages.text: Right-click to scan. It reports what is in your [#](7A3C9A)[chunk](entry://glossary/chunk)[#](), nearby, or just traces further away.

pages.title: Drilling Machine
pages.text: Needs rotation and a Drill (Iron, Diamond or Netherite). Output depends on the vein, including bonus items by chance.

pages.title: Sample Drill
pages.text: Pins down a vein's exact details into an Ore Vein Atlas. The Atlas also filters the Vein Finder to a chosen vein.

The Deposits add-on supplies the vein list:
- coal, copper, iron, zinc, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald, quartz and glowstone
- Nether gold, Nether quartz and ancient debris

Ancient debris needs a **Netherite Drill** and lava. Check the Atlas or [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

pages.title: Fluid Well Extractor
pages.text: Pulls fluid from a vein instead of items. Deposits include an Underground Spring that yields water.

Veins give raw ore, so crushing and washing still apply: [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Ore Guide](entry://materials/ore_guide)[#](). Drills need [#](2E5AAC)[stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#](). Lead and TFMG ores are not in the vein list.\
\
Deposits show as markers on [#](2E5AAC)[Xaero's maps](entry://home/maps)[#](), without a chat line each.
